note: Submodule of Toc.js. Adds a boolean node base field toc_js_active and a per-content-type opt-in stored as node type third-party settings under toc_js_per_node: 'override' (permit per-node enable/disable) and 'override_default' (default node state). The content type must already have toc_js.toc_js_active TRUE. Provides block plugin toc_js_per_node_block (extends TocJsBlock, adds override_nodetype) and permission 'administer toc_js per node'. Requires node+toc_js. No configure route/Drush. Introspection reads the per-node third-party settings; execution enables the per-node override and places a toc_js_per_node_block. Namespaced content types (tocjspn_*) and block, no node operations (safe on this shared site).

evals.prompt: How does the toc_js_per_node module let editors turn the table of contents on or off for one node, and what has to be enabled on the content type first?
evals.expected_output: It adds a boolean node base field toc_js_active and a per-node 'Display a table of contents' checkbox on the node form. The content type must have Toc.js enabled and the 'Permit to enable/disable toc per node' setting (third-party setting toc_js_per_node.override) turned on.

evals.prompt: Which block does toc_js_per_node provide, and what extra option does it add over the standard Toc.js block?
evals.expected_output: It provides the toc_js_per_node_block ('Toc.js per node block'), which extends the Toc.js block and adds an 'Override node type configuration' (override_nodetype) option; when off it uses the node type's TOC settings, and it always respects each node's toc_js_active flag.

evals.prompt: Which permission controls who can toggle the per-node table of contents in toc_js_per_node?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer toc_js per node' permission (or core's 'administer nodes') gates the per-node 'Display a table of contents' checkbox on the node form.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type tocjspn_doc uses Toc.js. Inspect the live configuration and state whether per-node override of the table of contents is enabled for it.
evals.expected_output: Yes: node.type.tocjspn_doc third_party_settings.toc_js_per_node.override is TRUE (per-node override enabled).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type tocjspn_def has per-node Toc.js override enabled. Inspect the live configuration and state the default per-node table-of-contents state (override_default) — is it enabled or disabled by default?
evals.expected_output: node.type.tocjspn_def third_party_settings.toc_js_per_node.override_default is FALSE, i.e. new nodes default to the TOC being disabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type tocjspn_page has Toc.js enabled but does not yet allow per-node control. Using toc_js_per_node, enable per-node override of the table of contents for tocjspn_page and apply it to the live site.
On this Drupal site, place a Toc.js per node block (the toc_js_per_node_block plugin) in a region, with id tocjspn_testblock, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a Block config entity with plugin 'toc_js_per_node_block' (id tocjspn_testblock) in the default theme in a region, with settings including override_nodetype and the toc_js defaultSettings, then save.
